verifiedInFixedSource.area: Raw condition decoder and whole-wire shape
verifiedInFixedSource.assessment: MAP7 alone uses roleAboutAt and the three aboutAt slots. The shared condition decoder admits only a known sent span/range or null, resolves raw text with outer trim, rejects blank or over80/200 UTF-16 content, and never cuts or silently nulls a non-null condition. form() explicitly rejects old keys or absence of the new key; exact object validation handles additional keys. Normalized MapReply still uses the existing about strings/null.

Claim condition owns its claim.at record; candidate statement condition owns statement.at rather than optional candidate.at; match condition owns match.at. Role condition owns one of the actually resolved basis records, and null role with non-null roleAboutAt is refused. This is source-location containment, not automatic proof that a raw passage describes the asserted semantic scope. Mixed-source role honesty remains a prompt/meaning gate.

Every non-null decoded condition is retained locally with its resolved coordinates and appended to contradictions() evidence before material-overlap checks. All four condition slots therefore participate in the existing whole-response material rejection. Conditions are not discarded before that check.

verifiedInFixedSource.area: FIRST6 and later7 production before hashing
verifiedInFixedSource.assessment: The builder produces the same map6 shape/record selection first and selects schema7 only after the actual complete ask is known non-FIRST at map-reading.ts:739. It returns the same ask object through MapInput. map-run.ts:118 reads laterPrompt only beside a valid m6 base capability; promptOf at123 selects the actual schema's recipe. Attempt input/prompt are fixed at146 and askHash is computed afterward at149. No post-hash schema substitution was introduced. An actual FIRST retains6 even with later7 advertised.

Base map.prompt remains the unchanged m6 recipe and laterPrompt advertises m7 separately. Standard provider dispatches MAP7_PROMPT only for actual schema7 and includes its anchored evidence hash. run.prompt now receives the validated submitted schema, so job admission compares the matching m6/m7 recipe. JOB_SCHEMAS and binding regex admit7 without a codec change. Status parsing ignores malformed later recipes and only accepts an exact m7 ID beside m6. Existing raw checked wire return behavior is retained, so a client can validate the incoming7 form itself.

verifiedInFixedSource.area: CLI explicit scope and immutable execution metadata
verifiedInFixedSource.assessment: The new explicit map7-later policy accepts FIRST6 or non-FIRST7 and rejects later6/first7. Old first/map6-later semantics are left on their original branch. instructions(), wrap() and askBinding() choose actual7-later versus6 FIRST/later, retaining exact selected prompt and ask hashes in the established acceptance/spawn checks. The policy hash includes the new scope while preserving the special historical first-policy hashing behavior. Capture/lease/limits/permissions/model/timers were not redesigned.

verifiedInFixedSource.area: Old wire, prompt and persisted shape
verifiedInFixedSource.assessment: map-prompt.mjs only appends the MAP7 derivation; it does not edit map1-6 exports or the m6 recipe. Guarded string replacements build a separate later7 string and distinguish incoming response keys from stored ask history fields. Existing map1-6 validation branches are unchanged except shared version inclusion and no-op calls outside7. applyReading treats7 as inheriting6 and therefore stores existing map-reading.5 in project14. Project/store validators and source metadata shapes were not changed. No FIRST7 prompt was added.

load() still decodes the saved job input, checks its immutable hashes/prompt against its own reservation, validates the raw response using inp.ask, and keeps op.binding.prompt. It does not rebuild from current status or reinterpret a saved6 wire as7. This supports the intended compatibility mechanism; a genuine pre116-produced ready6 recovery witness is still needed before claiming it was exercised.

promptContractAssessment.assessment: The prompt explicitly excludes metadata/current/priors/unsent records as raw conditions, forbids using a dependency/document commit as the supplied file version, defines same-record/basis/null-role ownership, specifies the80/200 non-null rejection bounds and null-with-text/evidence preservation, forbids mixed-source version synthesis, and includes material overlap. Existing source-kind restrictions and complete map6 meaning remain inherited.
promptContractAssessment.limit: This is a normative contract implementation. No actual model has demonstrated compliance, and the115 reply remains rejected and unchanged. A null condition can be syntactically lawful while omitting material scope; meaning review must still reject that omission.

testChangesAtThisCommit.observed: Only existing status assertions in map70/owned-cli102 tests are updated to include the standard provider's optional laterPrompt. Existing FIRST6 expected recipe was not mechanically changed to7. The policy example documents the new opt-in but retains scope:first.
testChangesAtThisCommit.unfinished: Dedicated condition-reference tests and a genuine pre116-ready6 fixture are not present in this fixed delta. Parent reports the single author is still writing them. This absence is recorded as incomplete evidence, not a newly discovered implementation failure or an acceptance claim.
requiredBeforeAcceptance: Distinct synthetic positive/negative fixtures for all four slots:80/200 exact boundaries, same-record/basis/null-role, old/new shape mixing, metadata/unknown anchors and material overlap; whole rejection and precise paths.

Before/after producer fingerprints proving the normal selected-RQ ask differs only in explicitly selected schema/capability identity, with raw source spans, declarations, fullRequests, priors and current understanding preserved. Hash the actual selected schema, not a pre-switch ask.
Normal client capability matrix and actual bound6-first/7-later prompt selection, plus provider/CLI fake response wiring. No model call is required for these mechanics.

Genuine ready6 input/wire/reservation produced with pre116 code recovered under later7 advertisement using its saved schema/prompt, without another invocation; project14 apply/reload and old records/bundle exact.

The selected normal UI delayed-ready→explicit apply→source/back→backup/reload path with a lawful distinct synthetic7 response, including truthful source declarations and retained report/check conditions. Root owns locked compilation/focused checks and actual private backup verification.

conclusion: No concrete actionable P1/P2 was found in this interim fixed source delta. The main designed boundaries are connected, including actual schema-before-hash selection and saved-schema ready recovery. The implementation is not accepted yet: targeted evidence, genuine old-ready witness, locked checks and final author delta remain outstanding. No model-quality or overall-product completion claim is justified.
